notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing a quick announcement to let you know I've uploaded a new build of the game. This build should fix a technical issue which prevented the music from being played properly during the opening scenes of the VN.

I've also fixed a couple of typos which were found in the English script, and I fixed a bug which prevented players from swapping back to the Spanish language option in the preferences screen after initially selecting a language.

As always, thank you to everybody for pointing these issues out. It's appreciated! If you find more issues in the game, do let me know, and I will try to fix everything in a timely manner.

- ebi x
